title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_rogue_heroes_by_ben_macintyre_o8fbf (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_rogue_heroes_by_ben_macintyre_o8fbf' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, uncompromised computer. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by it.
